import {afterlightGoal,afterlightStage} from './afterlight-world.mjs';
 function update(){const s=api.state(),zoom=s.skirmish?.scopeZoom||4;scope.hidden=true;$('crosswind-zoom').textContent=zoom+'x';finish?.update(s,{menu:!api.playing(),reduced:api.settings.reduced});nav.hidden=!(s.skirmish?.navigateUntil>s.time);if(!nav.hidden){const g=s.relays.size===3?'Return to Arrival Quay':'View / Atlas shows the next relay and tracked adventure';nav.textContent='▲ '+(s.expedition.tracked==='afterlight'&&afterlightStage(s)<5?afterlightGoal(s).name:g);}}

test('Expansion uses unique original IDs and preserves the original five districts',()=>{assert.equal(EXP_DISTRICTS.length,7);assert.equal(TASKS.length,14);for(const a of[EXP_DISTRICTS,EXP_BRIDGES,EXP_RAILS,EXP_ENEMIES,TASKS,THINGS,TRANSIT])assert.equal(new Set(a.map(x=>x.id)).size,a.length);assert.equal(RAILS.length,15);});
